turns.assessment: The decisive observation is the critical EQPT_PORT_FAIL on svc149's S11 client port at the same time the service failed. CLIENT_SF at both ends is consistent with propagation of that endpoint failure. Stable line-interface, channel, amplifier, power, OSNR, and BER telemetry, together with unaffected unprotected neighbouring services, strongly excludes an optical-path or shared OTN failure.

proposals.rationale: This exact port raised EQPT_PORT_FAIL at onset. A failed S11 client optic or port explains loss of svc149 and CLIENT_SF at both endpoints while leaving both optical lightpaths and other services normal.
An S06 client-port failure could interrupt only svc149 and produce endpoint CLIENT_SF, but it does not explain the explicit equipment-port failure alarm at S11.
